messages:
sarah: FYI escalated ticket from a customer running on Alpine CI. They installed the Python SDK with the `fastjson` extra and their job fails at import time. stack attached.

cheng: can you paste the minimal traceback / repro?

sarah: here — reproduced inside `python:3.11-alpine` docker: 
```
# repro (on alpine):
docker run --rm -it python:3.11-alpine sh -c '
  apk add --no-cache build-base musl-dev libgcc && \ 
  pip install "redwood-sdk[fastjson]" && \ 
  python -c "import redwood; print('ok')"
'
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/__init__.py", line 12, in <module>
    from ._json import dumps
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/_json.py", line 3, in <module>
    import orjson as _orjson
ImportError: libgcc_s.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
```

mike: hmm. so orjson wheel expects glibc binary. alpine is musl. we've seen orjson not ship musl wheels.

cheng: thanks — looks like the SDK eagerly imports `orjson` at module import time when the fastjson extra is present. on musl systems that can cause an immediate ImportError even if the app doesn’t need orjson. easy repro.

mike: workaround for customers: tell them to avoid the extra (`pip install redwood-sdk` without `[fastjson]`) or install the pure-Python fallback before importing: `pip install redwood-sdk && pip install --no-binary :none: orjson` — but building orjson from source on alpine needs build deps. better to avoid extra.

cheng: long term fix: make orjson an optional lazy import with try/except fallback to stdlib `json`. patching now to 1.4.1 to postpone import until feature call or use importlib.

sarah: can you add a small unit test and an alpine-tagged CI job so we don't regress? customer will need a prompt workaround in the meantime.

cheng: yes — I'll open a PR with: 
- lazy import in redwood/_json.py
- unit test that simulates ImportError for orjson and asserts fallback to `json`
- add a small `alpine` build matrix entry to CI that installs `python:3.11-alpine` and runs smoke tests
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1234 (WIP) :hammer_and_wrench:

mike: add a changelog note and a customer-facing KB blurb with repro + workaround. I'll draft KB.

sarah: sending workaround to customer now: 
"Temporary workaround: reinstall without the optional `fastjson` extra: `pip uninstall orjson && pip install redwood-sdk` or simply `pip install redwood-sdk` (do not include `[fastjson]`). We'll get a patch out shortly that avoids hard dependency on orjson at import time on musl systems."

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for patch branch redwood-sdk/1.4.1-lazy-orjson at 2025-03-22T14:00Z

cheng: pushed commit, added test, and CI entry. linking to the gist with the failing repro Dockerfile and commands: https://gist.github.com/cheng/abcdef123456

sarah: thanks all. customer confirmed they can use the no-extra install and will hold while we ship the patch. closing escalation once patch released and KB updated. :white_check_mark:
